title: Get a permit to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's permit before performing or offering entertainment in a public place for reward.

laws.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010

sources.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010
sources.locator: by-law 16(1) (version as in force at 5 August 2010)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not in a public place, without a permit, perform or offer entertainment for or in expectation of reward.
